palette: 暖米纸 parchment + 黛青 bench-teal + 朱砂 vermilion + 铜黄 bronze + 玄墨 ink
typography: double-bordered bench headings, teal condition strips, bronze verdict seals, vermilion rebuttal dashes
composition: a tiered weighing bench: two-stage evaluation lanes, age/capacity contrast rails, trident instigation fork, formal-vs-real tracks, role creed scroll
surface: parchment ground with teal-bronze line hatch, double-bordered paper boards, dashed rebuttal notes; no glossy panels
motion: verdict seals stamp scene by scene, tier rails descend with the evaluation, trident branches fork left-right; no idle loops
transition: parchment ground and teal header bar persist while each scene re-weighs the bench
